en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), and the Triplet on Leading to Accumulation (Ācayagāmittika).

Conditioned by a state that is non-demonstrable, with resistance, and not leading to accumulation, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, without resistance, and leading to accumulation, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is non-demonstrable, with resistance, and not leading to disintegration, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, without resistance, and leading to disintegration, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is visible and impinging, which neither leads to accumulation nor leads to dispersal, there arises a state that is visible and impinging, which neither leads to accumulation nor leads to dispersal, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Twenty-one [conditions] for root;
twenty-one for predominance … pe … twenty-one for non-disappearance.
